Definition: from G3509; properly, cloudiness, i.e. (concretely) a cloud:--cloud.
BiblicalUsage: A bright cloud overshadows the mountain and a voice speaks out of it, and a white cloud bears One like the Son of man with a sharp sickle. The fathers are under the cloud and pass through the sea, and the living shall be caught up together in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cloud is where God hides and where He reveals: it overshadows the mountain, it carries the Son of man, it covers the fathers in the sea, and it will carry me up to meet the Lord. The cloud is His chariot and His veil at once.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
